Commentary.Commentary: The ODI series trophy is handed to Kohli and the Indians assemble for the customary photoshoot. A thrilling series ends but these two sides will compete in the shortest format soon. The first T20I of the 3-match series will be held in Kanpur on January 26. It will be an early start as the match will begin at 1630 local, 1100 GMT. Do join us for that one. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

VIRAT KOHLI says that it's been a terrific series and feels that there have been several positives for the Indian team. Says that the team has shown character in tough situations throughout the series, singles out Jadhav and Pandya today. States that the former is a big find for sure and also says that Hardik is showing promise as the all-rounder. Adds that the surface provided his team the perfect platform to prepare for the Champions Trophy. Hopes that his bowlers can learn to adapt to overseas conditions when they head to England for the Champions Trophy in June.

EOIN MORGAN is relieved at salvaging some pride. Feels that it's been a very competitive series and admits that it took a lot of hard work to seal the win today. He is happy that his side managed to come back hard despite being 2-0 down. Says that the pitch looked more an English surface than Indian. Credits his openers for giving a good start and also praises his bowlers for doing well. Appreciates Woakes' temperament in the final over. Ends by saying that there were several positives for England despite losing the series.

KEDAR JADHAV (MAN OF THE SERIES) says that the idea for the final over was to play all the balls himself. Feels that he lost his balance on the lofted stroke and that cost him his wicket. Lauds Dhoni for influencing his attitude under pressure. Feels that there was some movement on the pitch for the fuller ball and says that dew helped the batsmen later on. Says that he has taken the challenge of finishing games and expresses happiness at it. States that he is happy at his MoS performance but is disappointed at losing the game.

BEN STOKES (MAN OF THE MATCH) says that he is happy at a good result at this venue after the horror experience in the previous game (WT20 final 2016). Says that he was looking to get his eye in while batting as it wasn't an easy track to start playing shots. Opines that he and Woakes were able to add valuable runs at the death. Adds that it has been a great series with lot of runs from both sides and expresses happiness at England salvaging a consolation win.

Unlike the previous two matches, this pitch did have a bit in it, especially for the pacers. England did well to post a challenging total that was propelled by a Stokes special as he carted a fifty while Woakes too stroked a valuable cameo. This was after England had messed up a solid platform provided by the top four with Roy and Bairstow scoring fifties. Eventually, every run mattered as it got down to the wire.

Pandya's dismissal swung the pendulum as England sneaked back into the game with regular wickets. With 16 needed off 6 balls, Jadhav clubbed a six and a four off the first two balls to thrill the crowd but Woakes held his nerve brilliantly to close out the game. Ball was the pick of the bowlers while Stokes also did well to pick crucial wickets. Woakes was expensive but eventually bowled the vital final over well to see his side through. This is their first ever ODI win at the Eden.

Another thrilling game and this time England found themselves on the right side of the result to notch up their first International win on their tour of India. Chasing a challenging 322 to win, India's openers failed once again and Kohli too couldn't convert a start after being dropped once. Yuvraj and Dhoni also failed to kick on after starts, leaving India in a dicey situation. However, Jadhav rose to the occasion and with Pandya, stitched a fantastic century stand to bring the hosts back in the game.

NO, HE CANNOT! Full and wide outside off, Kumar cannot put bat on ball and England players have a sense of relief on their faces. Woakes pumps his fists in delight and that's a consolation victory for the tourists. ENGLAND WIN BY 5 RUNS. INDIA TAKE THE SERIES 2-1.
6 needed from 1. Can Kumar do a Miandad?
JASPRIT BUMRAH is the last man in.

OUT! JADHAV HOLES OUT! There's a massive silence at the Eden. You can hear a pin drop now. Slower and fuller outside off, Jadhav goes for the loft over cover but doesn't get the distance on the stroke. Finds Billings near the ropes to perfection. Terrific innings comes to an end but he will be gutted at not finishing off things.
What a comeback from Woakes! Lovely yorker outside off, Jadhav cannot get bat on this. Two dots in a row and now the pressure is right back on the hosts. Superb bowling! 6 needed from 2 now.
Good length on off, Jadhav makes room and slaps it towards short cover. Dot ball. Momentum swings! Oh, cricket you beauty! 6 from 3 now.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! Jadhav you monstrous champ!! What an innings under pressure again! Fuller ball outside off, once again stays calm and he just lofts it over the covers to find the fence. 6 needed from 4 now.

SIX! CARVED AWAY! What a start to the over for India! Full and outside off, Jadhav stays deep in the crease and clobbers it high over deep cover for a biggie. Superb shot and that has eased the pressure for sure. 10 needed from 5 now.
CHRIS WOAKES to bowl the final over. 16 needed for India. Jadhav is on strike. Can he finish it well or will England gain a consolation win? Let's find out.
Another full toss and Jadhav once again mistimes the heave through mid-wicket. Just a single but he will keep the strike. England closing in on a win here although anything can happen.
Full toss but Jadhav cannot connect the heave well. Mistimes it to deep mid-wicket and they hare back for the second run.
Full and wide outside off, squeezed out towards point off the bottom edge. Refuses the single. Strange as Kumar can certainly bat.

FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! India won't mind this at all. Much-needed for the hosts. Fuller outside off, Jadhav throws his bat at it but gets a thick inside edge just past leg stump. Buttler dives to his left but it gets through to the fine leg fence. 19 needed from 9.
Full and wide outside off, Jadhav shuffles across to chase it but misses. Went past the tramline but the umpire made a good decision to give it a wide. Two dot balls in a row.
Very full and outside off, Jadhav cannot put bat on ball. Pressure mounts, 23 from 11 now.
JAKE BALL comes on to bowl the penultimate over. 23 needed from 12.
Fuller on middle, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Slower bouncer following Jadhav who was backing away to pull but misses. Slips down the leg side and that's a harsh call for a wide.

OUT! GONE! Ashwin succumbs to the pressure! Length ball on off, he goes for the heave. Wanted to clear mid on but gets only height on the stroke. Woakes at mid on settles easily under the skier. England have their noses in front at this moment now. 25 needed from 13 now.
Fuller on middle, wristed away to deep square leg for a single. Pressure building again as 25 needed from 14 now.
Length ball following the batsman, Jadhav makes room for the heave but it brushes the pads on its way to the keeper.
Slower ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to cover-point.

FOUR! LAUNCHED! Fuller on off, Jadhav lifts it straight over the bowler's head. Beautiful stroke and the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Superb over for India as 16 runs came off it and so the wicket hasn't dented the momentum.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN is the new man in.

OUT! JADEJA DEPARTS! Probably a shot too many from him in the over. Back of a length ball and he goes for the pull over mid-wicket. Finds Bairstow at deep mid-wicket to perfection. It can be argued that he could have worked it around after getting two boundaries in the over. England continue to chip away at the wickets.

FOUR! SMASHED AWAY! Brilliant strike this from Jadeja. This was a low full toss and not usually an easy one to hit in the end overs but he just bludgeons it past the bowler. Woakes got his fingertips to it but the ball races to the fence for a boundary. Tough to call it a dropped chance as he was literally saving his life. Both the bowler and umpire were in danger there.
FOUR! CLEAN STRIKE! Woakes misses the yorker and dishes out a full toss. Jadeja lifts it easily over mid off to find a welcome boundary for India. 35 needed from 21 now.
Fine yorker on middle, Jadhav makes room but can only dig it off the bottom edge to the keeper. Single taken.
Very full outside off, Jadeja squeezes it through point for a single.
Free Hit coming up.
High full toss and Jadhav looks to swing it on the leg side. Gets an edge that goes towards third man. Single taken. Free Hit but it's the new man to take strike.
CHRIS WOAKES comes back on. 43 needed from 24 now.
Fuller on middle and leg, Jadhav misses the flick and they steal a leg bye. Excellent over from Stokes, just 4 runs and a big wicket.
That was close! Back of a length outside off, slapped towards mid off for a tight single. The throw at the bowler's end misses and that saves Jadeja.
Fuller around leg stump, Jadeja misses the flick as the ball brushes off the pads down the leg side to the keeper.
RAVINDRA JADEJA is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Just the break England would have wanted. This is a horror stroke from Pandya though. Length ball on middle, he looks to play a wild hoick across the line but misses it completely to see his stumps disturbed. The 104-run stand is broken and England are now back in this. 45 needed from 27.
Full and outside off, whipped to mid on for a single.
Very full and outside off, jammed to mid off for a single.
BEN STOKES is back. 47 needed from 30 balls.
Short of a length outside off, flat batted stroke towards mid off where there is a fumble. Single taken and Pandya wanted the second too but rightly sent back.
Full on the stumps, Jadhav goes for the slog but miscues it towards deep mid-wicket. Another single.
100-run stand between Jadhav and Pandya.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and on off, mistimes the heave through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Maiden ODI fifty for Pandya.

SIX! CLEARS THE ROPES! Short ball is just not working for England and Nasser Hussain is very irritated on air. Another bumper and Pandya swivels to pull it just over fine leg for a biggie. Very useful innings this from the all-rounder.
Full and very wide outside off, Jadhav was backing away and cannot reach it.
Full toss on middle, lofted over wide mid on to the deep for a single.
Shortish down the leg side, Pandya swivels to pull but makes no contact. Wide called.
Back of a length outside off, Pandya has a go at it but misses.

NOT OUT! Dug in short around off, Pandya was undone by the extra bounce as he looked to fend. It lobbed up to Buttler and England went up for the appeal. There was some sort of a noise there. Ball was very confident but not the umpire. Morgan takes the review. Replays show that it came off the shoulder. So, the on-field call stays as it is.
England have taken a review for caught behind against Pandya. Ball seems very, very confident.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Jadhav is toying with the bowling. Another short ball on middle and leg, he camps back and gets across to pull it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. This short ball ploy is certainly not working to this man.
JAKE BALL is back on. 65 needed from 42 now. Game on for sure.
Fuller on the pads, Pandya glances it down to fine leg where it is well stopped. Brace taken.
Length ball on middle, Pandya makes room for the shot but it sneaks between bat and pad.

FOUR! Another lucky boundary for Pandya! Back of a length on off, he looks to hack it over mid-wicket but gets a thick edge that goes very fine to the third man fence for a boundary. What a day he is having though! First three wickets with the ball and now with the bat, he is chugging along albeit with some luck too.
On middle and leg, Jadhav steps out and takes it on the full to whip it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! BLASTED AWAY! Dug in short on middle, Jadhav stays on the back foot and pulls it ferociously to the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary. The chase is livening up now.
Good length on off, nips in sharply as it sneaks between bat and pad. Jadhav was backing away.
Shortish on middle, Jadhav pulls it on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Pandya swings at it but gets it off the outside edge well over point. Falls safe in the deep as the batsmen get a single.
Change of bat for Pandya. Not sure why, especially after such a super shot. Maybe he wants to deal in sixes.

FOUR! Hammered! Fuller ball outside off, Pandya makes room and smacks it past mid off to find the fence. Not sure if that was the length to bowl with mid off up in the ring. Perhaps a double bluff from Stokes.
Good length on middle and leg, Jadhav is struck on the thigh pad and they get a leg bye.
Maiden ODI fifty for Jadhav.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Jadhav is on the charge! Length ball outside off, clobbers it down the ground. Clears mid on easily and it goes to the fence for a boundary. Much-needed one for the hosts. 83 from 52 balls now.
Dug in short outside off, Pandya muscles the pull over mid-wicket. Protection in the deep and so just a single. The chase is getting tougher for the Indians.
Fuller outside off, crunched down the ground to long on for a single.
Length ball outside off, makes room and pats it to mid off for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, worked to deep mid-wicket for a run. England won't mind the singles.
Full and outside off, makes room and smacks it to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Pandya muscles the pull to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length angled in on off, Pandya backs away for the big shot but adjusts to tap it on to the track.
LIAM PLUNKETT is back.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders can be allowed outside the ring now. Both batsmen had a change of bat after the last over. Slogging time now with 93 needed from 60.
Full toss on middle, chipped towards mid-wicket and almost carried to the fielder there. Single taken.
Slower bouncer on middle, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Full toss outside off, steered towards point for a single.
Shortish on middle, Jadhav swivels to pull it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length on middle, steps out and clips it on the leg side for a single. Throw at the bowler's end misses, would have been close had that hit.

SIX! HOW DID HE HIT IT THERE? These bats I tell you! Slower length ball outside off, Pandya swings wildly at it but gets a thickish edge on it. Big maximum. Pandya didn't intend to hit it there but will take the result.

FOUR! 2 in 2 for Jadhav! Attempted yorker turns into a low full toss, he just gets across a bit and deflects it neatly to the fine leg fence for another boundary. Productive over for the Indians this.

FOUR! CONNECTS THIS TIME! Some relief for the Indians this time. Back of a length outside off, Jadhav stays deep in the crease and flat bats it comfortably over mid off. Almost went all the way for a biggie.
Another play and a miss! The pressure is visible clearly now as both batsmen are trying wild slogs and missing. Jadhav this time as he gives the charge for the big stroke but fails to connect.
Back of a length outside off, Jadhav plays with an angled bat but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to the keeper.
Shortish outside off, awkward looking angled bat stroke from Pandya towards third man for a single.
Pandya was backing away and Woakes spears it wider outside off. Fails to connect the slash. Dot ball. Pressure building on the hosts now. 113 from 71 now.
Back of a length outside off, Jadhav gets across and looks to pull across the line but misses.
Very full and outside off, squeezed out through the covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, crunched through the covers for a single.
Good length on off, gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
Swing and a miss! Length ball outside off, Pandya has a wild hoick at it but misses.
Shortish on middle, Jadhav swivels to pull but gets a faint under edge on to the rib as the ball rolls to the leg side. Single taken.
Good length outside off, steered with an angled bat just past a diving backward point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Jadhav looks for the cut but misses.
Short and around off, Pandya ramps it towards third man. One bounce to the fielder for a single.
Almost an edge! Back of a length outside off, extra bounce and Pandya is beaten on the poke.
Another short ball and this time Jadhav shovels the pull over mid-wicket. Mistimed it a bit nobody in the ring as the ball races to the deep. Single taken.
Nice bumper around off, Jadhav goes for the pull but misses.
Pandey has come out to do a bit of taping to Pandya's blade.
Fuller on off, carved away just over point as the ball goes to the deep for a brace.
Almost a replica of the previous ball except that this time Pandya misses the flick. Wide called.
FOUR! Deft touch! Sprayed down the leg side and Pandya capitalizes on the offering. Glances it very deftly down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length around off, Pandya backs away for the slog but gets it off the toe end towards point.
Length ball on middle, worked on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Back of a length down the leg side, worked to deep square leg for a single.
BEN STOKES comes back for another burst. 129 needed from 90 balls now.
Back of a length on middle, clipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, jumps across and whips it on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks it to point.
Length ball on the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single. Pandya lost his bat as soon as he completed the stroke and then took the run without the blade.
Good length angled in on off, Pandey looks to poke at it but is beaten as the ball straightens a bit after pitching.
Back of a length on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
CHRIS WOAKES is back on.
Back of a length outside off, Pandya nails the back foot punch past cover for a brace.
Dug in short on off, Pandya looks for the ramp over the keeper but fails to connect.
Fuller outside off, nice punchy drive towards extra cover. Ali makes a good stop diving to his left from mid off. Saved a certain boundary.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav goes forward to push at it but the ball nips back sharply off the seam. Sneaks between bat and pad to go through to the keeper.
Short and outside off, Jadhav flashes the cut but misses.
FOUR! SUPER SHOT! Short of a length on middle, Jadhav rocks back and controls the pull superbly to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Used the pace of the bowler very effectively.
Floated outside off, Jadhav steps out and chips it over the infield on the off side. Mistimed it a bit but it landed safely. Brace taken.
Fuller outside off, drilled through the covers for a single. Good stop in the deep by the fielder.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked past mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, leans into it and pats it to the leg side.
Fuller on off, bunted through mid on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Jadhav steers it down to third man for a single.
Weird shot! Good length around off, Pandya swings wildly at it and misses completely.
Second slip comes in.

FOUR! OFF THE EDGE! Almost another wicket for England. Back of a length outside off, Pandya pokes tentatively at it and gets an edge that just goes past first slip to the third man fence for a boundary. Almost a horror start for the all-rounder.
HARDIK PANDYA is the new man in.
Drinks break...

OUT! HUGE BLOW! Back of a length outside off, Dhoni goes for the booming drive on the up but only manages a thick edge through to Buttler who takes another sharp catch. Almost similar to the Kohli dismissal this and India have now lost half their side. 149 needed from 110 balls.
Back of a length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Short of a length on middle and leg, Jadhav hangs back and clips it to long leg for a run.
Very full on the stumps, Dhoni gets across and jams it to mid on for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Dhoni lunges into it and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy on leg stump, glanced towards backward square leg for a run.
On the shorter side on middle, Dhoni stays back and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Drifting in on middle, Jadhav works it towards square leg for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Dhoni steps out for the big heave on the leg side but is struck on the pads off the inside edge. He wanted to launch that into orbit and probably went too hard at it.
Fuller on off, whipped away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length on middle and leg, walks across and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, cut away through backward point for a single.

FOUR! SMART BATTING! The third man was placed very fine for his late cut and what does Jadhav do? Play it very square! Back of a length ball outside off, Jadhav opens the face to steer it towards the third man fence for a boundary. Ball is livid at not seeing third man at the normal position.
Good length on middle, Dhoni walks across the sticks and clips it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! SWATTED AWAY! Banged in short on middle, sat up to be hit at that pace and Dhoni obliged with a meaty pull over mid-wicket. Looked a boundary from the moment he made contact.
JAKE BALL is back on.
FOUR! That's a Jadhav special! Flatter outside off, he stays back and cuts it very, very late. Beats short third man comfortably to get another boundary. Productive over for India.
FOUR! TOP EDGE FALLS SAFE! Flatter on middle, premeditated sweep from Jadhav but skews it just over short fine leg. Races away to the fence. Jadhav knows he got lucky there.
Flatter on the pads, Dhoni gets across and tucks it down to backward square leg for a single.
Sharp turn! The off break spins in sharply as Jadhav makes room to cut. Goes off the edge towards short third man for a single.
Fuller on off, Jadhav steps out and pats it back to the bowler.
Loopy well outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks.
Good length on off, gets back and clips it to the leg side. Wanted the single but is sent back by Jadhav.
Very full and around off, squeezed towards mid on for a tight single.
Back of a length outside off, slapped to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Slips one down the leg side, Dhoni lets it pass and it's a wide.
Fuller outside off, uppish square drive that just falls short of point.

SIX! SMACKED AWAY! Short from Plunkett and Dhoni goes for the swivel pull. Gets it high on the bat and the ball sails way over fine leg for a maximum. It looked like he was late on the shot initially but this man has terrific power and it was on display.
Fired in on middle, stays back and taps it to the leg side.
Fuller outside off, bunted gently to mid off.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, nudged to the leg side.
Flighted around off, gets well forward and works it to short mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, gets well forward and works it to short mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Another full ball outside off, Jadhav times the drive nicely to cover.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
KEDAR JADHAV is the new man in.

OUT! YUVRAJ DEPARTS! Found the man in the deep to perfection. Fuller on middle and leg, he just goes across and whips it over mid-wicket. Struck it really well but got the placement wrong as the distance wasn't there on the shot. Billings near the ropes hardly had to budge and he takes the catch with ease. India in a bit of trouble now. 189 needed from 147.
That sprung off the deck. Good length outside off, extra bounce as the ball hits him high on the bat.
Back of a length on off, Dhoni gets back and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from around off, leans forward and pats it to cover.
Floated on middle and leg, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Yuvraj drills it down to long off for a single.
Almost a wicket! Full toss and Yuvraj nearly popped it back to Moeen.
Fuller and outside off, whacked down to long on for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Yuvraj steps out but Ali alters the line. Misses the flick and it goes off the pads to square leg. They take a single.
Shortish around off, another solid back foot defence from Dhoni.
Back of a length angled in on off, defended solidly off the back foot down the track.
Short outside off, Yuvraj swivels to pull but gets a bottom edge down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle, Yuvraj gets across and checks his drive to mid on.
Length ball on off, seams in a bit as Dhoni nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, Dhoni watches the ball pass by.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes back on for another spell.

SIX! WHACK! Yuvraj continues to motor along merrily. Flatter on a length on middle, he stays back and shovels the pull way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. He is once again in supreme touch at the moment.
Flatter on middle, worked off the back foot on the leg side for a single.
Four leg byes! Handy runs at this stage. Floated around middle, turns in a bit as Dhoni looks to flick but misses. It goes off the pads past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Looped up around off, wrists it towards square leg where it is well stopped.
Tossed up outside off, Dhoni gets forward and works it towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter on a length around off, whipped away off the back foot to long on for a single.
Length ball very wide outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, gets across and dug out past mid-wicket for a single.
Good length on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Dhoni walks across the sticks and pats it back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, flashes the cut towards third man for a single.

FOUR! KABOOM! That made a cracking sound off the blade. His pull shots when he is on song is such a delight. Stokes tried the back of length ball around off, Yuvraj stands tall and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. Clean strike and you don't need to run for those.
Full and around off, leans across and punches it down the ground to long on for a single.
Very full around off, Yuvraj jams it back to the bowler.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Yuvraj at his very best. Fuller ball outside off, leans forward and thumps the drive through the covers. Timed so well as the ball races away to the fence.
Floated on a length around off, Yuvraj gets back to whip it away but gets an inside edge on to the thigh.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and pats it towards cover.
Floated on off, gets back and works it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball wider outside off, Dhoni gets across and lets it pass.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
MS DHONI walks out to bat.

OUT! MASSIVE WICKET! Somehow Kohli didn't look fluent after that dropped chance and he has to go. Back of a length ball wider outside off, he chases it and gets an edge that is pouched well by Buttler behind the stumps. The ball was really traveling after the edge and it was a sharp catch. So, the dropped catch doesn't cost England much. India have been jolted. 220 needed from 182 now.
Good length outside off, Kohli hangs back to play the drive but gets an inside edge on to the track.
Good length on off, Yuvraj gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, driven fluently to deep cover for a single.
Flatter on a length on middle, whipped through square leg for a single.
Loopy on middle, gets across and works it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, Yuvraj hangs back and whips it to long on for a single.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Yuvraj misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads to short mid-wicket. A leg bye taken.
Floated around off, Yuvraj looks to block but it goes off the outer half to short third man.
MOEEN ALI to bowl his off spin.
Fuller on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Very full and around leg stump, Yuvraj misses the flick and that's a wide. Harsh call.
Full and just outside off, seaming away as Yuvraj lets it pass.
Length ball on leg stump, worked through square leg for a single.
Good length angled in on leg, Kohli misses the flick and is struck on the pads. Muted lbw appeal that is turned down. Looked like just missing leg.
Good length outside off, steered with soft hands as the ball goes on the bounce to wide slip.
Sprays it way down the leg side, Kohli once again fails to put bat on ball. Another wide.
39th ODI fifty for Kohli.
Fuller on off, Kohli drives it back firmly towards Stokes who gets a hand as he tries to deflect it to the non-striker's end. Instead parries it straight down the ground for a brace.
Back of a length way down the leg side, Kohli chases it but misses. Wide called.
Good length closer to off, blocked well from the crease.
FOUR! Yuvraj is on fire! Short of a length on leg stump, easy for him as he swivels to play a pull towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Shortish on leg stump, Yuvraj ducks to give a wide.
FOUR! MAULED! Shortish on off, Yuvraj swivels and pulls it powerfully over deep mid-wicket. Hit it so well that it nearly went all the way.
Good length on off, worked away to the leg side.
Shortish on middle, worked off the back foot past mid-wicket for a single.
Drinks break...
Pitched outside off, Yuvraj taps it towards cover.
Good length on off, Yuvraj gets an inside edge on to the track.
Short of a length around off, hits high on the bat as Yuvi looks to block.
FOUR! SPANKED! Short around off, Yuvraj stands tall and pulls it powerfully over wide mid on. Came off the toe end but still cleared the infield comfortably to find the fence.
Good length angled away on off, blocked from the crease to mid off.
Dug in short on middle, Kohli swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for a single. Slight fumble but no harm done.
BEN STOKES comes into the attack.
Good length closer to off, tapped towards mid on for a single.
Fuller and angled in on off, pushed gently back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.

Short ball outside off, lures Kohli into the pull once more but this time the batsman misses. Virat needs to be careful with his shot selection to short balls. He seems to be a compulsive puller and that can put him in trouble, as it did in that dropped chance.
FOUR! Nicely done by Kohli! Shortish outside off, he stays back and plays the late cut. Gets it easily past gully to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Shortish outside off, gets back and taps it to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, Yuvraj gets back and jabs it to the off side.
Good length outside off, this time the inside edge results and the ball goes off the pads to the off side. They take a quick run.

BEATEN! Kohli is struggling at the moment, yes you read it right. The Indian captain seems to be a tentative all of a sudden. It's excellent bowling from England too actually. Fuller ball outside off, swings in sharply to beat the inside edge as Kohli looks to drive.
Back of a length on middle, gets across and tucks it towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length angled in from outside off, Yuvraj pushes at it but is beaten.
Good length outside off, this is a good leave from Kohli.
FOUR! MORE LUCK FOR KOHLI! This is brilliant stuff from Plunkett. Length ball around off, finds the inside edge that just goes past leg stump as it races away to the fine leg fence.
Good length outside off, Kohli gets a bottom edge as he looks to steer it to third man.

DROPPED BY BALL! Has he dropped the match? Too early to say but just cannot put down Kohli in a run chase especially. Short ball around off, Virat goes for the pull but the ball climbs on him. Gets a top edge to fine leg where Ball puts down a simple chance after having got to the ball. Brace added. The crowd roar in delight.
Shortish outside off, nips in a bit off the seam as the ball sneaks under the bat.
Back of a length around leg, Yuvraj shuffles across on the back foot and plays a short arm jab down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, gets back and jabs it to point.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli taps it gently to the off side.
Shortish around off, Yuvraj mistimes the pull to mid on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, steers it down to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length on off, gets across and tucks it towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on leg stump, gets across and tucks it past square leg for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Kohli gets across and clips it sweetly through mid-wicket. Fine save near the ropes by Billings to save a couple of runs for his side.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli gets back and taps it to point.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller around off, swinging in, Kohli gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Full and wide outside off, Yuvraj drives it towards backward point where the fielder makes a good half-stop to prevent a certain boundary. Parries the ball to the deep as the batsmen take a single.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes into the attack.
Good length on leg stump, worked to short fine leg for a single.
Fuller around off, Yuvraj gets it off the inside half on the drive towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks solidly.
Yuvraj takes a bit of time but he is ready to resume. Kohli walks up to him and shares a light moment with his partner.
OUCH! That has stung for sure and Yuvraj is in some pain. Back of a length angled into him, bounces extra off the deck to rap him on the chest. He drops his bat instantly in reaction to the pain.
Length ball well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and blocks it well to the off side.
Length ball outside off, hangs back and dabs it towards point.
Second slip moves to short extra cover.
Good length angled in  off, Kohli looks to block and gets a soft leading edge down the track.

FOUR! AWESOME TIMING! This man can do wrong it seems. Back of a length just outside off, only a hint of width and that is enough for Kohli. Stands tall and laces the cut behind point for a boundary. Ominous signs for England these. They need to get him early.
Fuller and just outside off, left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! Excellent shot! That was a decent delivery on a length around off, most batsmen may have looked to play it on the off side but not Kohli. This man is in such form that uses his wrists to flick it powerfully through square leg. Timing is so good that the ball rockets to the ropes. Wow!
Full and on off, gets across and drives it to mid on.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, Yuvraj gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Kohli looks to steer it down to third man but gets off the outside edge. Just short of second slip where Roy fumbles a bit. Concedes the single.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Shortish on middle, Yuvraj gets across and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Shortish on middle and leg, Kohli misses the flick and the ball rolls off the thigh pad towards backward square leg. They take a leg bye.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller on the pads, nicely flicked but straight to mid-wicket.
Beaten again! Shortish around off, Yuvraj gets across to flick but is beaten.
Good length just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Lovely ball! Good length angled away around off, Yuvraj is rooted to the crease as he fishes at the delivery and is beaten.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and steers it down to third man for a single.
YUVRAJ SINGH comes out to bat.

OUT! BALL STRIKES! Rahul's hyperactive knock comes to an end. He never looked settled and has to go. Short ball around off, he shuffles across and swivels for a mighty pull but gets a big top edge on it. The ball goes high in the air and Buttler goes a few yards to his left to take the skier. India's openers have failed one more time.
Good length around off, blocked well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, gets back and steers it down to third man for a single. 1000 runs as ODI captain for Kohli.
Length ball on off, gets across and blocks it well.
FOUR! Up and over! Short of a length outside off, Kohli stands tall and flat bats it over cover-point. Cleared the infield comfortably to find the fence.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
JAKE BALL comes on to bowl.
Willey is off the field. He had pulled a muscle on his left hand in his previous over.
Play and a miss! Back of a length on middle, Rahul backs away a lot to play a booming shot but fails to connect as the ball goes over the sticks.
Shortish outside off, gets back and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, gets on the front foot and defends it well.
Good length on middle, gets across and clips it to the leg side.
FOUR! VIRAT KOHLI SPECIAL! What a shot! Full and outside off, Kohli gets the stride forward and creams the drive through the covers. Nobody moved at all as that whistled to the ropes. Classy shot!
Good length closer to off, Kohli blocks it well from the crease.
Fuller on middle, gets across and punches it towards mid on.
Another attempted inswinger but well down the leg side, wide signaled again.
Good length outside off, Kohli pushes at it but gets it off the edge down to third man for a single.
Speared well outside off, Kohli chases it but doesn't make contact.
Full and down the leg side, Kohli misses the flick and it's a wide.
Good length on middle and leg, Kohli misses the flick but is struck on the thigh pad.
Good length outside off, Rahul steers it down to third man for a single to rotate strike.
Short of a length well down the leg side, easy leave for Rahul and it's a leave.
Very full on middle, Rahul gets across and squeezes it out towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli blocks with an angled bat towards point.
Good length closer to off, another watchful leave by Kohli.
Length ball on fourth stump line, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! And again! Woakes is too straight once more and Kohli picks him away through mid-wicket this time with a wristy flick. Lovely timing and it races away to the fence once more.
FOUR! FREEBIE AND PUT AWAY! Straying on the pads and Kohli whips it away through backward square leg with aplomb to find the fence. Cannot afford to give such gifts to a batsman of his class.
Lovely ball! Woakes is steaming in at the moment. Baclk of a length around off, seams away very late as Kohli is squared up on the back foot push.

Full and around leg stump, Rahul shuffles but misses the flick to be rapped on the pads. Muted lbw appeal from England which is turned down. Looked like just missing leg stump and might have pitched outside leg as well.
Good length on middle and leg, Kohli gets across and tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
VIRAT KOHLI is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Lovely inswinging yorker around off, finally Willey gets his line and reaps the reward instantly. Rahane plays all around the delivery and is late to get his bat down. The ball crashes into the stumps and that's the early wicket England wanted. Rahane fails on his comeback and India's opening woes continue.
Poor shot! Full and angling away from well outside off, Rahane looks for the booming drive but is beaten.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot but straight to cover.
Bowls the inswinger but the line is way down the leg side. Another wide.
Very full around off, Rahane jams it towards mid off. Got his bat down just in time.
Slips it well down the leg side, Rahane misses the flick stroke. Wide called.
DAVID WILLEY to take the other new ball.
FOUR! Whipped away! Fuller on middle and leg, Rahul shuffles across and flicks it aerially over mid-wicket. Clears the infield easily to find the fence.
SIX! LAUNCHED! Shortish around off, Rahul makes room and lofts it high over extra cover. There was a lot of height on the stroke but importantly had the distance as well. Terrific stroke!
Shortish outside off, Rahul is undone by the extra bounce once more as he gets an edge on the push.
Dug in short outside off, once again the ball rears off the deck as Rahul lets it pass.
Good length around off, Rahane hangs back and taps it towards backward point for a quick single.

RIPPER TO START! Back of a length closer to off, extra bounce takes Rahane by surprise. The ball whizzes past the outside edge. Oh wait, replays show that there was a slight amount of glove on it! Rahane is a lucky man.
We are back for the chase! AJINKYA RAHANE and KL RAHUL to open the batting for India. CHRIS WOAKES to take the new ball.
